Take V={a,b}, T1=T2 with the single edge e={a,b}. Removing e from T1 gives components A={a}, B={b}. The unique T2 path from a to b is just the edge {a,b}, so the constructed f is {a,b}=e, which is in T1. Thus the local claim 'f cannot belong to T1' is false, although the main exchange statement still holds in this instance.
